label: TP
reason:
Alert 1 (xss) alert-TP: Data flows from request.getParameter to param, then to bar via param.replaceAll("<[^>]+>", ""). The regex strips tags but fails to prevent context-breaking payloads like ">". At the sink (response.getWriter().println), the resolved value contains attacker-controlled script content that executes because the

tag is closed prematurely. The custom sanitizer is insufficient.

evidence.note: User input retrieved, regex sanitized, reflected to writer
